cues: Can becomes could; may becomes might; must, meaning obligation, becomes had to; will and shall become would; and shall in an offer becomes should.
But would, could, might, should and ought to have no further past, so they never change.
text: Modals shift too. Can becomes could; may becomes might; must, meaning obligation, becomes had to; will and shall become would; and shall in an offer becomes should. But would, could, might, should and ought to have no further past, so they never change.
